meta.promptText: India mein 2000 rupees ke andar men ke liye konse brand ki jeans kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
India mein ₹2,000 ke budget mein men ke liye kai saare acche aur reliable denim brands available hain, jo style, durability aur comfort provide karte hain. Yahan kuch top brands aur unke options diye gaye hain:

Levi's sales aur discounts ke dauran ₹2,000 ke andar **iconic style** aur **durable cotton fabric** provide karta hai.

The Indian Garage Co budget-friendly fashion ke liye mashhoor hai, jo **stretchable comfort** aur **versatile slim fits** offer karta hai.

H&M ke yeh jeans **relaxed straight fit** aur modern look ke sath aate hain, jo daily wear ke liye best hain.
